sources.entry: juntagrico - Management platform for community gardens and vegetable cooperatives. (Source Code) LGPL-3.0 Python

summary.one_liner: juntagrico is a management platform for community gardens and vegetable cooperatives, covering subscriptions, shares, deliveries and members.
summary.what_it_does: juntagrico is a web-based management platform aimed at community gardens and vegetable cooperatives. According to the README, it provides subscription management, extra subscription management, share management, delivery management, and member management. Detailed installation and configuration documentation is hosted on readthedocs. A public demo instance is available, and the README notes a demo login exists. The README gives no further detail on specific features beyond this list.
use_cases: manage extra subscriptions for a farm cooperative
how_to_run: Read the installation and configuration documentation at juntagrico.readthedocs.io
Try the demo at demo.juntagrico.science (username and password are both admin)
Follow the development setup guide referenced in the README for contributing
notable: Built specifically for cooperative vegetable growers and CSA operations
Covers share and subscription management together with delivery scheduling
Public demo instance available for trying it out
Community translation effort mentioned in the README
caveats: The README does not state system requirements or hosting platform details; see the external documentation
Setup details are not included in the README itself, only a link to external docs
